data.title: LPL Financial Completes $750 Million Senior Notes Offering
data.description:
An update from LPL Financial ( (LPLA) ) is now available.

LPL Holdings, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of LPL Financial Holdings Inc., completed the issuance and sale on November 18, 2026, of $750 million of 5.850% senior notes due 2029. The senior unsecured obligations were fully and unconditionally guaranteed on a senior unsecured basis by LPL Financial Holdings.

The notes will mature on November 16, 2029, and pay interest semiannually at an annual rate of 5.850%, beginning May 16, 2027. On November 16, 2026, the company and guarantor entered an underwriting agreement for the registered public offering, which allows the company to redeem the notes before October 16, 2029, under a Treasury-rate-based formula and thereafter at 100% of principal plus accrued interest.

data.title: Tronox Reassures Investors on Liquidity Amid Creditor Reports
data.description:
TRONOX ( (TROX) ) has provided an announcement.

On November 18, 2026, Tronox responded to a November 17 Wall Street Journal article reporting that two groups of its creditors had engaged law firms labeled “restructuring advisors”; the company said it had never engaged with either group or its advisors. The company said the engagements were formed last year; the article said one was recently reinstated, but Tronox said neither development signaled imminent or likely negotiations.

Tronox reported $509 million of liquidity at September 30, 2026, comprising $136 million in cash and cash equivalents and $373 million available under revolving credit agreements, and said its next significant debt maturity was not until 2029. The company said it had no financial covenants on term loans or bonds and that its chief executive was confident it had ample liquidity to operate and remain current on obligations.

data.title: Vodafone Reports H1 FY27 Revenue Growth and €3.6 Billion Loss
data.description:
Vodafone ( (VOD) ) just unveiled an update.

Vodafone Group Plc, a provider of mobile and fixed connectivity, financial services and digital solutions across European and African markets, reported H1 FY27 results on November 18, 2026. Total revenue rose 11.4% to €21.9 billion and service revenue increased 12.8% to €18.4 billion, including 5.8% organic growth, with consolidation of Safaricom, VodafoneThree and Telekom Romania contributing to total revenue.

Vodafone reported a €3.6 billion loss for the period, compared with a €1.1 billion profit in H1 FY26, citing non-cash charges including a Germany impairment and a UK deferred-tax-asset write-down; these were partly offset by a non-cash gain from the Safaricom transaction. The interim dividend rose 2.5% to 2.306 eurocents per share, while H1 gross opex savings reached €0.2 billion and about 3,000 role reductions were delivered in Europe and shared operations.

On November 18, 2026, Genmab announced that its Board of Directors had decided to grant 4,993 restricted stock units and 4,607 warrants to employees of the company and its subsidiaries. data.title: AI Era Corp Completes Acquisition of AI Script-to-Video Pipeline
data.description:

On November 10, 2026, AI Era Corp. agreed to acquire Honrado Filmes Inteligencia Artificial Limitada’s AI Script-to-Video Pipeline for $3 million, comprising $2 million in 200 million shares and $1 million in cash payable within 90 days. data.title: Banco Santander Brasil Plans Oct. 28 Release of 3Q26 Financial Statements
data.description:
The latest update is out from Banco Santander Brasil ( (BSBR) ).

Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. is a Brazilian bank headquartered in São Paulo. The release presented performance commentary and condensed consolidated financial statements for the period ended September 30, 2026, prepared under IAS 34.

The commentary described clearer signs of a Brazilian slowdown in 3Q26, including 0.5% second-quarter GDP growth, slower credit and weaker household consumption, as the effects of restrictive monetary policy became more evident. It also reported easing inflation alongside elevated services inflation and deteriorating longer-term expectations, while global oil volatility and higher long-term interest rates contributed to tighter financial conditions.

data.title: INLIF Amends Warrants, Sets Series B Exercise Price at $0.30
data.description:

The amendment replaced the previously determined reset price of $0.51 per Unit with $0.30 per Unit, effective November 17, 2026, while leaving the initial exercise price unchanged and proportionately increasing the number of issuable Units so the aggregate exercise price remained equal to that on the October 20 issuance date.

data.title: Drugs Made in America Acquisition II Consolidates Convertible Note Financing
data.description:
An update from Drugs Made In America Acquisition II Corp. ( (DMII) ) is now available.

On November 6, 2026, Tal Alpha Yezum Vekidum Asakim (2003) Ltd. funded a further $250,000 under its $1.4 million convertible-notes commitment to Drugs Made in America Acquisition II Corp., bringing funded financing to $700,000 with $700,000 remaining. The parties agreed to consolidate the prior notes and new installment into a $700,000 note maturing June 30, 2027, replacing notes otherwise due in December 2026; it retained a 35% discount conversion feature tied to a business combination.

On October 29, 2026, the Company delivered Alpha AI Biotech Group a preliminary proposal that Alpha accepted in principle on October 30, 2026, contemplating a $600 million pre-money valuation payable in 60 million Company shares, plus up to 30 million earn-out shares tied to $12.50 and $15 share-price thresholds over 24 months after closing. The Company’s board approved a limited 30-day standstill on November 3, 2026, restricting only completion of competing transactions; the proposal remained nonbinding except for confidentiality, the standstill and funding acknowledgment, and no definitive agreement had been executed.

data.title: TNL Mediagene Regains Compliance With Nasdaq Equity Rule
data.description:
TNL Mediagene ( (TNMG) ) has shared an announcement.

TNL Mediagene is a Taipei-headquartered technology and digital media company providing AI-driven advertising, marketing technology, content commerce and data analytics solutions to brands and agencies across Asia. It also operates multi-language Chinese- and English-language digital media brands spanning business, technology, lifestyle and culture.

On November 16, 2026, Nasdaq confirmed that TNL Mediagene had regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(b)(1), which requires at least $2.5 million in stockholders’ equity. Nasdaq reached the determination after reviewing the company’s October 30 Form 6-K and supplemental pro forma financial information provided following completion of the sale of its Japanese operating subsidiaries.

The company satisfied the Nasdaq Hearings Panel’s August 23 decision but is subject to a Mandatory Panel Monitor for one year from Nasdaq’s letter. If the company again falls out of compliance during that period, Nasdaq staff will issue a Delist Determination Letter without allowing a compliance plan or additional cure period, although the company may request a new hearing.

data.title: SQM Reports Nine-Month 2026 Revenue and Net Income Growth
data.description:
Sociedad Quimica Y Minera SA ( (SQM) ) has provided an announcement.

SQM is a Chilean chemical and mining company with businesses in lithium, iodine, specialty plant nutrition, industrial chemicals and metallic exploration. Its lithium operations span Chile and other countries, while iodine demand is driven primarily by X-ray contrast media and plant nutrition products are sold in markets including the United States, Mexico and Spain.

On Nov. 17, SQM reported nine-month 2026 revenue of US$6,340.5 million and net income of US$1,569.0 million, up 95.0% and 288.0% year over year, respectively, while gross profit rose 233.6% to US$3,002.3 million. Year-over-year sales volumes rose in lithium and iodine, realized prices increased across main business lines, and lithium and derivatives accounted for 79% of consolidated gross profit.

data.title: Goldgroup Mining Reports Multi-Asset Drilling and Technical Work
data.description:
Goldgroup Mining ( (TSE:GORO) ) has provided an update.

On Nov. 6, 2026, Goldgroup Mining reported drilling, exploration and technical studies across its four 100%-owned precious-metals assets in Mexico and the United States. Work included a 26,000-metre San Francisco drilling program and mine-planning studies, resource replacement and regional exploration at Don David, sonic drilling tied to Cerro Prieto heap re-leaching, and a Back Forty feasibility study.

At Don David, the company said it had completed approximately 25,726 metres in 123 holes during the first seven months of 2026, with more than 97% directed to resource definition and expansion; at Cerro Prieto, 26 of 45 sonic holes totaling 1,009 of 1,554 metres had been drilled. The update described work spanning production, exploration and development, with stated objectives including resource growth or replacement, mine planning and mine-life opportunities.

data.title: First Community Bancshares Announces New Stock Repurchase Plan
data.description:
First Community Bancshares ( (FCBC) ) has issued an announcement.

On November 17, 2026, First Community Bankshares, Inc.’s board adopted a stock repurchase plan for 3.0 million common shares, with purchases commencing November 18. Repurchases may occur through open-market purchases, privately negotiated transactions or other means, subject to business, economic, market, corporate and regulatory considerations, prevailing stock prices and applicable restrictions.

The plan is effective through December 31, 2029, may be suspended, terminated or modified at any time, and does not require the company to purchase a particular number of shares. It effectively replaces and terminates the plan adopted September 26, 2023, which would have expired December 31, 2026.
